newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi to discuss WTO membership at Singapore meet.
newsitem.headline: Saudi to discuss WTO membership at Singapore meet.

text.p: Saudi Arabia will hold talks on the sidelines of the first ministerial meeting of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) in Singapore to discuss its bid to join the world body, the official Saudi Press Agency said.
SPA said late on Sunday Commerce Minister Osama bin Jaafar bin Ibrahim Faqih will address the week-long meeting of ministers from 128 countries which opened on Sunday.

It said Faqih will "hold meetings with several of the ministers attending the talks as well as WTO officials to discuss trade relations...and the issue of the kingdom joining the WTO and how steps in that regard are proceeding."

Saudi Arabia, the world's largest oil producer and exporter, is pushing hard for quick entry to the WTO and has pledged to make every effort to satisfy trading partners it was committed to observe the body's rules.
It is seeking membership as a developing country, which would give it a special transitional period to bring its legislation and practices into line with WTO rules.
